prompt: Review this uncommitted change to the terminal dashboard (a log tail view, peer client names and scores, a txpool panel). Report blockers and should-fix items with file:line.

expected.gold_summary: Blocker: console/Sanitize is quadratic on unterminated ESC ] / 0x9d string introducers and converts the whole input to code points; its input includes a peer-chosen Hello clientId of up to 16 MiB, sanitized on every poll and every log line quoting it. Fix: bound the input read and scan linearly. Should-fix: the log ring loses writes (getAndIncrement then an unconditional set races); the Peers panel draws the Unresponsive reason (an exception message) raw, without the external-text sanitizer.

rubric: Flags Sanitize as a blocker: super-linear on unterminated escape-string introducers
Names the peer-controlled source (Hello clientId, large) that makes it exploitable
Proposes a bounded input plus a linear scan
Names the log ring's lost-write race (index increment then unconditional set)
Names the Unresponsive reason drawn raw (not passed through the sanitizer) in the Peers panel
protocol: prism: findings by lens and severity with file:line
